title_zh: 免費網上講座：治療師的情緒羅盤——誰來照顧照顧者（12 月 5 日）
title_en: The Therapist's Emotional Compass: Who Cares for the Ones Who Care? (Divit Mindspace, 5 December)
summary_zh: Divit Mindspace 免費網上講座，由 RCI 註冊臨床心理學家 Ankita Bhatnagar 主講，對象為心理健康專業人員。內容圍繞治療師如何辨認自己的耗竭訊號，談同情疲勞、倦怠、替代性創傷與實用自我照顧策略。2026 年 12 月 5 日星期六 18:00–19:30（印度時間）Google Meet 舉行，須預先報名。
summary_en: A free online webinar from Divit Mindspace, presented by RCI-licensed clinical psychologist Ankita Bhatnagar, for mental health professionals. It covers how therapists can recognise their own exhaustion signals, including compassion fatigue, burnout, vicarious trauma and practical self-care strategies. Held Saturday 5 December 2026, 18:00-19:30 (India time) on Google Meet; advance registration required.
